totalPaid.why: display quantum. The page paints fmtMoney (2dp), so a display-space comparison cannot resolve below $0.01; 2 cents allows one rounding step on each side. NOT a relative floor — deliberately, so that a large-balance divergence cannot hide under a percentage.

payment.why: the painted FIRST-SEGMENT regular payment (see driver.js). One cent wider than dos_fuzzer5_test.go:2683 (0.011) because the page paints to 2dp and DOS reports 4.

apr.why: rate space. The UI renders (apr*100).toFixed(4), so the display quantum is 5e-7; 2e-6 matches the engine fuzzer's flat APR tolerance at dos_fuzzer5_test.go:2909 so the two instruments are comparable. No floor term.

retiresToZero.why: the painted final balance. A whole dollar is deliberately loose: this is a sanity check on the schedule, not a convergence claim.

tell.message: THE TELL: no case diverges on payment — no mapping-bug signature.
